statute: Zakon o lokalnim porezima (NN 115/16, 101/17, 114/22, 114/23, 152/24) čl. 26 st. 1-2 (0,60-8,00 EUR per m² of useful area a year, set by the municipal council's decision), čl. 27 st. 1 t. 1-2 (not on property used for permanent residence or let for permanent residence at least ten months), čl. 2 st. 1 t. 12 (residential property)
dated: NN 152/2024 (Zakon o izmjenama i dopuni Zakona o lokalnim porezima), in force 1.1.2025 (čl. 15); lexifina/croatia-law zakon/2024/2504
unsupported: no capital-city rate declared: the Zagreb decision (odluka o lokalnim porezima) for 2025 was not reached (rate input localRates.propertyTax)
a dwelling let for permanent residence at least ten months a year is exempt (čl. 27 st. 1 t. 2): give no rate for it
rates by zone and the increase for age or amenities (čl. 26 st. 5-6) are the municipality's: give the rate that applies
business premises are not 'nekretnina' (čl. 2 st. 1 t. 12): only residential property other than the main home is read
local_rate: the municipality's rate is an input: localRates.propertyTax
